decisions.reason: The formwork profile line sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, and with no evidence from 2020 to 2021 showing failure, keeping the option open remains sensible.
Automated distributor flow control is embedded in the firm's automation systems and fits its strategic direction, so its upside justifies the low holding cost.
The shuttering magnet line is a cheap accessory adjacent to the core formwork business, and nothing in the results reveals that its value will not be realized.
The magnetic component with its own page complements the formwork offer at minimal cost, so there is no reason to abandon the option.
Overlap with other magnetic products makes F the likeliest candidate for consolidation, but holding costs are minimal and the evidence is not decisive enough to justify dropping it.
